item.title: Boy among 2 killed after truck drives onto Wichita soccer field
item.description: A 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man were killed during a soccer game at Stryker Soccer Complex in Wichita, Kansas, according to police.

item.title: Iran says offer, conditions to reopen Strait of Hormuz still on
item.description: Iran's foreign minister said the U.S. could see the strategic waterway open within days if it abided by the conditions presented in the seven-day ceasefire plan.

item.title: CBS News poll: Talarico-Paxton Senate race is a Texas toss-up
item.description: Turnout will be key as Texans voice cost of living concerns in Senate race between Ken Paxton and James Talarico.

item.title: Pope Leo says he will resume activities after cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV​ thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday, one day after being discharged from the hospital for cancer surgery.

item.title: Rep. Turner calls for congressional probe into Starlink disruption
item.description: GOP Rep. Mike Turner of Ohio called for a congressional investigation into disruptions in Ukraine to satellite communications with Starlink, the technology owned by SpaceX's Elon Musk.

item.title: Trump endorses Israel's Netanyahu ahead of reelection bid
item.description: Israelis are set to vote Oct. 27, in the first national elections since the 2023 Hamas attack on Israel.

item.title: Alberta is voting on staying in Canada. Here's a look at other separatist movements.
item.description: The province of Alberta is voting to either remain in Canada or begin the process for a binding referendum on separation from the country. Ian Lee takes a look at other separatist movements seen in Canada and around the world.

item.title: More than 1,800 arrested in France after protester violence erupts
item.description: Authorities said masked groups on Saturday set fires and attacked public buildings, including city halls, in several cities.

item.title: Candidate for Lt. Gov. Shawn Oliver arrested, suspends campaign
item.description: Shawn Oliver, a New Bedford City Council member and Republican candidate for lieutenant governor, suspended his campaign after he was arrested early Sunday morning.

item.title: Ukraine launches 1,000 drones at Russia, strikes set oil facilities ablaze
item.description: The strikes came as tensions between Ukraine and Washington deepened.

item.title: CBS News political panel dives into election trends
item.description: With two weeks and two days to go before Election Day, CBS executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto dives in the latest polling, while CBS News correspondents Ed O'Keefe and Caitlin Huey-Burns join to discuss what they've seen on the campaign trail.

item.title: Air Force member dies in rappelling incident at UT San Antonio football game
item.description: A service member was injured and later died after falling while rappelling from the ceiling of the University of Texas at San Antonio football stadium on Saturday.

item.title: GOP Sen. Cramer says he agrees with Republicans who have criticized waiving Russian sanctions
item.description: Republican Sen. Kevin Cramer says he agrees with members of his party who have criticized the Trump administration for waiving sanctions that target Russia and buyers of Russian oil, saying that "capitulating to a bully generally means they're going to make more demands going forward."

item.title: Ukraine, Sudan immigrants to retain deportation protections for now
item.description: The TPS protections of tens of thousands of Ukrainians and hundreds of Sudanese immigrants were officially slated to terminate on Monday.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV delivers Sunday Angelus prayer overlooking St. Peter's Square
item.description: Days after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous nodule from his lung, Pope Leo XIV delivered the traditional Sunday Angelus prayer from the Vatican, overlooking St. Peter's Square.

item.title: Trump says D.C. golf course construction will start next month
item.description: President Trump said Sunday that construction at the historic East Potomac Golf Links course will begin Nov. 15.

item.title: Senate candidate Angie Nixon says she "previously had very little support" from Democratic party
item.description: Florida state Rep. Angie Nixon, who is the Democratic nominee for Senate, told "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that her upstart campaign "previously had very little support" from national Democrats. That is now changing, and she said she welcomes all support because "we are not the little engine that could."

item.title: 4 dead after large fire breaks out at Canadian military base, officials say
item.description: Canada's defense minister said four service members were killed, and dozens of others were wounded, in an incident at a military base that caused a major fire.

item.title: Face the Nation: Cramer, political panel
item.description: Missed the second half of the show? GOP Sen. Kevin Cramer of North Dakota joins, plus our political panel of Caitlin Huey-Burns, Ed O'Keefe and Anthony Salvanto.

item.title: Book excerpt: "Your Turn: How to Create a Midlife You Love"
item.description: NPR health and science correspondent and "Sunday Morning" contributor Allison Aubrey writes about the steps Gen Xers may take to foster a sense of purpose as they enter this next stage of life.

item.title: Rep. Turner calls for congressional probe into Starlink slowdown that disrupted Ukraine drones
item.description: Rep. Mike Turner, who is on the Senate Armed Services Committee, said on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" that the slowdown in speeds for Elon Musk's Starlink and Starshield is "something where there needs to be a congressional investigation." Secretary of State Marco Rubio said "nobody" in the U.S. government ordered any slowdown.

item.title: CBS News poll shows a Texas toss-up with Talarico, Paxton in tight Senate race
item.description: With early voting starting Monday in Texas in the closely watched Senate race between Democrat James Talarico and Republican Ken Paxton, CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto dives into our latest poll of the Lone Star State.

Plus, a conversation with Florida's Democratic Senate candidate Angie Nixon.

item.title: The Vote | Sunday on 60 Minutes
item.description:
On Friday, the Justice Department threatened to prosecute California election officials who knowingly count mail-in ballots from people the Trump administration identified as "likely noncitizens."
This Sunday, 60 Minutes reports on state and local election officials who are resisting what they see as pressure from Washington.

Plus, a conversation with Florida's Democratic Senate candidate Angie Nixon.

item.title: In Michigan, consumer sentiment is pessimistic before midterms
item.description: Due to high fuel and housing costs, and wages that aren't keeping pace with inflation, consumer sentiment is lower than at almost any other time in modern history. CBS News spoke with Michiganders to find out how the economy is playing on the minds of voters.
